description: This file 'TextureRenderer.java' defines a Java class that handles OpenGL rendering of textures, including shader setup, buffer configuration, and rendering logic for an Android application that applies media effects.

classes.name: TextureRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering textures using OpenGL ES 2.0 in an Android environment. It manages shader programs, texture and vertex buffers, and performs rendering while adapting to view and texture size changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the shader program, retrieves attribute and uniform locations, and sets up coordinate buffers.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Deletes the OpenGL shader program to free resources.

methods.name: updateTextureSize
methods.description: Updates internal texture width and height variables and recalculates output vertices for aspect ratio correction.

methods.name: updateViewSize
methods.description: Updates view dimensions and recalculates output vertices for aspect ratio correction.

methods.name: renderTexture
methods.description: Binds the framebuffer, sets up shader program, attributes, texture, and executes drawing commands to render the texture to the screen.

methods.name: computeOutputVertices
methods.description: Calculates vertex coordinates to maintain aspect ratios based on current texture and view sizes.
